At Stamford Bridge, 첼시 introduce their new "electric fence" aimed at combating hooliganism. They draw 1–1 with 토트넘 홋스퍼 and the fence is not switched on. 버밍엄 시티's 1–0 win at 반즐리 puts them on the verge of an immediate return to the First Division but the third promotion spot is still up for grabs. 블랙번 로버스 lose 1–0 at 찰턴 애슬레틱 so 맨체스터 시티 move into the driving seat with a 2–1 win at 포츠머스 while 리즈 유나이티드 keep their faint hopes alive by beating 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 1–0.

events.title: Many promotion and relegation issues remain undecided on the penultimate Saturday of the League season. events.title: 에버턴 beat 퀸스 파크 레인저스 2–0 in front of over 50,000 at Goodison Park and are league champions for the first time since 1970. 선덜랜드 lose 2–0 at 레스터 시티 and are relegated. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 go down to the Third Division despite beating 허더즈필드 타운 2–1 in front of a crowd of 4,422, the lowest ever for a league match at Molineux . The second half at 노츠 카운티 is delayed by half an hour as 맨체스터 시티 fans riot with their team 3–0 behind. County eventually run out 3–2 winners to improve their chances of avoiding relegation and deal a blow to City's promotion hopes.

events.title: A black day for English football. Fifty-six people are burnt to death and more than 200 others injured at Valley Parade , Bradford in a fire caused by a discarded cigarette which set light to waste beneath the wooden main stand. The speed with which the blaze spread was astonishing. Tragedy also at 버밍엄 시티 where rioting 리즈 유나이티드 fans hold up play and later cause the collapse of a brick wall, killing a 15-year-old boy. 맨체스터 시티 beat 찰턴 애슬레틱 5–1 and clinch promotion to the First Division ahead of 포츠머스 on goal difference while at the other end 노츠 카운티 and 카디프 시티 are relegated. 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 secure the Second Division title with a 4–0 win over 반즐리. 밀월 are promoted from the Third Division but 프레스턴 노스 엔드 and Orient go down to be joined by either 스완지 시티 or 번리. 에버턴's unbeaten run of 28 league and cup matches comes to end as they go down to a Garry Birtles goal at 노팅엄 포리스트.

events.title: Thirty-nine spectators, most of them Italian, are killed when a wall collapses at the European Cup final between 리버풀 and 유벤투스 at the Heysel Stadium in Brussels . Despite the tragedy, the match is played and 미셸 플라티니 scores from a penalty as 유벤투스 win 1–0. UEFA later bans all English clubs indefinitely from European competitions as a result of the disaster. Just hours before kick-off, Joe Fagan had announced that he would be retiring as 리버풀 manager after two seasons in charge.
